token_dependency_contracts.required: Correct Generic Token Aura creation, own-controller end-phase destruction+one ordered draw; token ceases outsideArena rather than becomingGY. End-phase automatic layer timing has a separate rule witness; no source attack card is given draw directly.
Correct Generic Token Item creation; supported Action2+destroy cost paid before draw, AP1 spent then ownGA restored on resolution, one known draw, no duplicate token/GY.

Correct Elemental Token Aura; own NAA while defending+1def, AA/otherplayer excluded, stacking copies; at beginning of controller action phase destroy. Keep begin-phase no-priority rules and ordinary snapshot evidence distinct.

Correct Elemental Token Aura; source attack does not retroactively getGA. Next AA play creates independent trigger, source remains live before trigger resolution, destroy token+grantGA only on resolve. NAA/weapon/Instant exclusion and multiple tokens separately trigger. Native FaBELEPlayed currently destroys/tags eagerly; this is source-predicted held behavior, not an executed failure.

not_excluded_as_interactions: Trigger-versus-effect timing and priority before creation.
Full block/one-damage hit/full prevention and hero-only qualifier versus ally hit.
Independent repeated copies and no retroactive self-goagain.
Required token semantics are explicit dependency contracts; tokens are not silently declared complete.
external_holds: Ability loss/restoration/copy or suppression before event/after already queued trigger. An already-triggered layer must not be canceled by source suppression; this requires real supported effect witness.
Foreign owner/controller, multiplayer targets and simultaneous hit triggers/replacement ordering.
Token multipliers/replacements/prohibitions, Florian/Victor/Ripple/Verdant/global listeners, prevention interactions outside named witness.
progression: Independently review four prospective pilots, then root runs serial correct-rule attempts. If actual eager trigger bug is demonstrated, retain failure/reproducer and hold positive recording until a bounded independently reviewed repair. After valid pilot/negative controls, author and run all planned ordinary requirements in source-equivalent sub-batches; no arbitrary stop after pilots.
